source.title: Direct evidence of the South Java Current system in Ombai Strait
source.rights_statement: Copyright Elsevier; author-copy cover carries reuse restrictions. Original PDF is not redistributed by this record.

range_meaning: Approximate confinement scale described for the southeast monsoon; neither paired velocity edges nor sampled annual extrema.
region: Northern Ombai Strait; not the entire Sumatra-Java current system
sst_climatology_period_as_reported: 1986-2008; source describes22years, exact data coverage not independently reconstructed
sst_temporal_processing: Monthly climatology and monthly frontal-position analysis; source fills about10percent missing transect SST using time/space interpolation.
frontal_position_proxy: Latitude of maximum SST gradient near125degreesE
support_limits: Two moorings show contrasting flow; they are not repeated cross-strait velocity transects.
A temperature-front proxy is not automatically a velocity-current boundary.
The surface SJC and deeper SJUC are distinguished in the source; their dimensions are not interchangeable.
next_action: Add typed cross-shore source context with the SST proxy, region and season retained; do not increment paired-current-width or annual-range coverage.
